theme_and_archetype.rationale: To convey an elite, futuristic, and premium corporate mobility conglomerate. The dark theme emphasizes luxury (black), while the high-contrast orange provides functional, tactical highlights (Performance/Utility) matching the brand's 'WE MOVE YOU!' identity.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento 'Control Room' for fleet details, 'Tetris' asymmetry for Hero and Trust Pillars.
spacing_and_layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections. Allow the dark void to breathe.
spacing_and_layout.max_width: max-w-7xl mx-auto for content, full bleed for imagery.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.cards: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look) - sharp edges, 1px subtle borders (border-white/10), no soft shadows. Add a sharp bottom accent line on hover.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.header: Glassmorphism ('Crystal' Variant) - bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-2xl with border-b border-white/10.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.buttons: Flat solid primary (#EE5A01) with sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm) for primary CTAs. Ghost variants for secondary with border-[#EE5A01] text-[#EE5A01].

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Text color shifts to Off-White, subtle scale (-translate-y-1) for cards, border color transitions to Deep Orange.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up (using framer-motion) for statistics and grid cards.
motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is highly recommended. Parallax effect on hero backgrounds.

components.hero_section: Full screen (min-h-screen), text left-aligned, glowing orange abstract background image under a black/50 overlay. CTA linking to Europcar booking engine.
components.statistics_counter: Stark monospace numbers counting up, accented in primary orange, separated by sharp 1px vertical borders.
components.fleet_carousel: Edge-to-edge swiper/carousel. Images must have high contrast. Use custom arrow navigation outside the images.
components.trust_pillars: 3-column grid. Icons in orange. Minimalist text.
components.awards_ticker: react-fast-marquee text-Off-White/50. Slow movement. Uppercase serif/mono font.
components.brand_division_showcase: Bento grid. Heavy use of image overlays. Hover state reveals more info via motion.div.
components.contact_form: Shadcn UI form customized to have sharp inputs, bg-black, border-cool_gray/30. Highlight focus with #EE5A01 ring.
components.timeline: Vertical line in orange (#EE5A01), dots marking years. Intersecting observer triggers animation.
components.navigation: Sticky nav. If logo is black, apply 'filter brightness-0 invert' in CSS so it shows up on dark background.

logo.instruction: CRITICAL: The logo is black. Apply CSS class 'invert brightness-0' or style={{ filter: 'brightness(0) invert(1)' }} so it appears white on the dark UI.

hero_abstract_bg.description: Futuristic abstract geometric background with orange lines for Home Hero

premium_fleet_detail.description: Close-up of luxury car grille with cinematic lighting
premium_fleet_detail.placement: Services or About Page split section image

car_driving.description: Black luxury car driving on city street

chauffeur_door.placement: Services Detail or Trust Pillars image

dubai_skyline.placement: UAE Locations Map background or About Hero

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme (#000000) with #EE5A01 orange accents. No pure white backgrounds.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide icons customized with stroke width 1.5.
Integrate Shadcn components (Cards, Carousel/Slider, Tabs, Forms) but completely override the default styling to match the sharp, premium, no-border-radius (or max rounded-sm) aesthetic.
Ensure 'data-testid' attributes are attached to all interactive elements.
Use 'invert brightness-0' utility classes on the EGMG Black logo so it is visible on the dark header.
Add an external link CTA button for 'Europcar Booking Engine' on the hero and sticky nav.
Implement the Contact Form component keeping in mind that the backend will use MongoDB (add standard handleSubmit logic mapped to a mock or real fetch call).
Avoid typical rounded soft shadows. Use neon-like subtle glow dropshadows or hard 1px borders.
